scope: Representation laws and open fidelity questions; no semantic parity waiver.

normalizations.statement: Convert code-point offsets through the canonical public converter; preserve exact source slices and boundary validity.

Normalize exact/variation/all-edition candidate bags for representation only while preserving multiplicity, chosen editions, filtering, resource hashes and legal decisions. Retain raw relative order for source hash inputs when stable abbreviation ties distinguish it; never derive runtime hash order from an artifact-sorted bag.
Encode integers outside the exact JavaScript numeric range as decimal-string records; preserve their complete mathematical value.
Represent Python datetimes as ISO text while preserving every captured date component and date-based decision.
Canonicalize sets and unordered mappings by complete normalized values; preserve all elements and membership relationships.
Replace repeated deeply immutable values with content-hash references; retain full values and do not memoize mutable citation-bearing resources.
Represent oracle callable identities with source-bound descriptors in evidence; implement callable behavior through injected services and never request functions.
Map canonical Python citation classes to semantic union discriminants without requiring inheritance or losing observable legal fields/method behavior.
Represent document/citation cycles through explicit owned document data and relationships; do not drop observable document behavior.
Represent process memory identities as test-local slots; preserve identity relations and exact observed hash integers.
Map frozen oracle vocabulary to public identities while preserving historical parser metadata, ambiguity and distinct historical authority semantics.

questions.blocker: A deterministic diff selects the first repeated source citation while the public locator rejects duplicate matches. Prove separate operation contracts or preserve canonical rendering without manufacturing an anchor.
Diff reconciliation collapses a deleted occurrence to an empty insertion. Prove rendering behavior separately from nonempty verified citation evidence.
The annotation API accepts a zero-width insertion but the prerequisite rejects it as a nonempty text range. Preserve both operation contracts without inventing a mention.
The oracle warning arguments include source text; preserve the observable warning decision while satisfying the engine privacy and diagnostic-translation contract.
